notes.title: Patch 0.2.1082
notes.notes:
It's time for the "Goddess News" again, and "Ark" has been updated!
Bug Fixes

 Updated the unlock conditions for Chapter 5-6 and Chapter 5-8 to prevent some players from being unable to play Chapter 5.
 Fixed an issue in the second playthrough where, after a story character's permanent death, substitute characters could still be purchased in the shop, which could cause story errors.
 Fixed an issue in consecutive battles (e.g., 5-4-1 BOSS) where the skill card menu overlapped with the character card menu, making some characters unselectable.

Balance

 Updated the random value range for equipment stats.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1081
notes.notes:
It's time for the "Goddess News" again, and "Ark" has been updated!

 When viewing any protagonist-related CG, both the female and male protagonist CGs will now unlock simultaneously, instead of unlocking only the gender selected for that playthrough.
 Updated the unlock conditions for Chapter 4-11.
 Updated the story dialogue.
 Gallery feature now support Steam cloud.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where Eve's exclusive weapon caused splash damage that would prevent the battle from continuing.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1080
notes.notes:
It's time for the "Goddess News" again, and "Ark" has been updated!
Bug Fixes

 Fixed Chapter 3 dialoging
 Fixed the locking conditions for Chapter 5-2.
 Fixed sometime can still deploy leaved member on deploy menu.

Balance

 The enemy scaling in "Medium" and "Hard" modes in new game plus has been reduced, and enemy MOV will not scale up.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1079
notes.notes:
It's time for the "Goddess News" again, and "Ark" has been updated!

 Update Japanese localization.
 Substitute characters are no longer restricted character story feature in new game plus.
 Gold and achievements earned from the first playthrough can now be carried over to new game plus.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the health boost provided by the "Ark's Proof," "Crown of Illusion," and "Jinosuke's Crown" did not update the current HP accordingly.
 Fixed an issue where the "Snow Sprite" event might not trigger on stages with initial falling tiles.
 Fixed an issue where "Medusa Cooperation" could only be triggered once.

Balance
Endgame Rewards Changes:

 Clear Count Reward: Increased from 400 to 1000
 Exclusive Weapon Reward: Increased from 400 to 500
 Defeat Strengthening Purchase: Improved from -400 to -200
 Achievement and Character Title Rewards: Increased from 400 to 500

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1077
notes.notes:
It's time for the "Goddess News" again, and "Ark" has been updated!

Bug Fixes

 Increased the damage of the "Clear" skill to 999 to ensure obstacles can be cleared in one hit on hard difficulty.
 Fixed an issue in controller mode where selecting "redraw" in the random event screen would prevent further selections.
 Fixed an issue where the challenge condition "All Allies Survive" included relic units, making it impossible to complete this condition with certain strategies.

Balance
The following achievement conditions have been updated:

 Great Wealthily: Purchase 60 skills from the shop changed to 40 times.
 Extreme Seeker: Teammates die 30 times changed to 20 times.
 Last Stand: Teammates die 60 times changed to 30 times.
 Weapon Collector: Obtain 10 different types of equipment changed to 5 types.
 Collector: Obtain 30 different types of equipment changed to 15 types.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1075
notes.notes:
It's time for the "Goddess News" again, and "Ark" has been updated!

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where summoning "Iamus" through the "Fire in the Hole" skill caused the battle to freeze when the skill to summon "The Book of Iamus" was used, preventing the battle from continuing.
 Fixed an issue where using the combination of "Unified Offense and Defense" and "Medusa Cooperation" to strike a target protected by "Shield of Ren II" would cause the battle to freeze.
 Fixed the description of the "Fangs" skill.
 Fixed an issue where the "Harden" skill did not negate damage caused by "Counterattack."
 Fixed an issue where the resurrection effect from "Undead Relic" allowed revival outside of the expected tile range.
 Fixed an issue where the "Mad Vrykolakas" given in the story was not retrieved after passing the 4-9-5 BOSS stage.
 Fixed a problem where Steam achievements were not functioning properly, and any unlocked achievements would now be corrected after loading progress.

Balance

 Targets affected by "Encirclement" will no longer trigger resurrection-type skills, such as: Jinosuke's Guardian 2, Resurrection of the Dead, Jinosuke King's Exclusive Weapon, Undead Relic, Undead, and Dark Minions.
 The shop has added the skill "True Bloodthirsty Dragon" under the Level 3 "Special" category. Unlike the original "Bloodthirsty Dragon," it has no limit on the number of activations per turn.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1073
notes.notes:
It's time for the "Goddess News" again, and the firmware for "Ark" has been updated once more.
We would like to thank all the players who have provided feedback, suggestions, and comments in the discussion forum. We have read every message, but due to limited manpower, our responses may be a bit slow. However, we will do our best to fix known issues and provide a better gaming experience for everyone.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an error where certain characters did not return to the team, causing the route that requires all characters in Chapter 5-1 to be inaccessible.
 Fixed an issue where battles would not proceed when all target tiles required by "Jinosuke's Guardian 2" were destroyed by divine punishment.
 Fixed the display issue of substitute character cards in the second playthrough.
 Fixed Vrykolakas's outpost dialog.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1072
notes.notes:
It's time for the "Goddess News" again, and "Ark" has updated its firmware.
This update introduces a cloud save feature, so please prioritize playing the game on the device that has the latest save data to avoid save errors.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where the Celestine in Chapter 4-6 was not properly added to the team.
 Fixed an issue in the 4-2-1 BOSS stage where fulfilling the condition to defeat the smoke would not trigger the victory condition.
 Fixed an issue where pressing the controller button on the game startup screen would display the language options.
 Fixed an issue where rapidly pressing the controller button on the game startup screen would prematurely open the character selection screen.
 Fixed an issue where clicking on an empty save slot during the loading screen would prevent the smooth selection of other save slots.
 Fixed a display issue with the death CG when multiple death events were triggered.
 Fixed a problem that could cause repeated triggers during shop screen operations.
 Fixed an issue where equipping both the "Exclusive Weapon" of Citrine and "Aid of Ren" at the same time would prevent the two-action effect of the exclusive weapon from activating.

Balance:

 "Bloodthirsty" ability will now only activate once per turn.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.1069
notes.notes:
it's time for Goddess News, The 'Ark' has been updated.
Bug Fixed:

 Fix type with certain key on custom name can mess up the creation process
 Fix battle 3-6-3BOSS challenge condition setting
 Fix some consumable item can disappear after load save file
